story_title: NVIDIA Unveils Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard to Cut Agentic AI Costs
caption:
NVIDIA just took aim at the biggest barrier to enterprise AI agents: operating costs. 

Instead of sending every request to massive frontier models, NVIDIA's new Nemotron 3.5 Lightning (30B MoE) and NeMo Switchyard open-source router dynamically assign tasks. 

In benchmarks with LangChain, intelligent routing achieved 74% lower costs by sending only 7% of calls to expensive frontier models—while preserving accuracy. 

Are you building single-model systems or routed systems of models? Let us know below.

alt_text_overall: Carousel explaining NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Lightning and NeMo Switchyard open source model routing library, detailing up to 66% cost reductions for agentic AI.
alt_text_per_slide: Slide 1: AI AGENTS JUST GOT 66% CHEAPER.. NVIDIA launched a system that routes AI tasks automatically—slashing frontier model costs to nearly one-third. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

Slide 2: STOP USING ONE MODEL FOR EVERYTHING.. Always-on agents waste tokens when using frontier models for simple tasks like billing, code formatting, or log parsing. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 3: 74% LOWER COST IN MULTI-TURN TESTS.. In LangChain benchmarks across 145 multi-turn tasks, NeMo Switchyard routed only 7% of calls to a frontier model, maintaining near-frontier accuracy. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 4: ENTER NEMOTRON 3.5 LIGHTNING.. NVIDIA's new 30B parameter Mixture-of-Experts model delivers up to 4x faster output speed and 30% faster task completion for specialized agent duties. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 5: NEMO SWITCHYARD DIRECTS TRAFFIC.. An open-source library that dynamically routes prompts based on latency, accuracy, and budget constraints without requiring application code rewrites. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 6: THE SHIFT FROM CHATBOTS TO AGENT SYSTEMS.. Future AI applications won't run on a single mega-model. They will rely on orchestrators routing queries across local, specialized, and frontier models. — shown as a numbered slide beside a large offset circle.

Slide 7: INTELLIGENT ROUTING IS THE NEW OPTIMIZATION.. By pairing open 30B specialized models with smart routing, autonomous AI becomes economically viable at enterprise scale. — shown as a bold statement over a torn-edge color block.

fact_check.claim: NeMo Switchyard maintains frontier-level accuracy while reducing task completion cost to nearly one-third of Opus 4.8 alone in internal benchmarks.
Nemotron 3.5 Lightning is a 30-billion-parameter mixture-of-experts model.
LangChain achieved 74% lower cost in 145 multi-turn Deep Agents tasks by routing 7% of calls to a frontier model.
